messages.en: What place did you come in earlier?
Only third, but I broke my own record!

senses.en_definition: A moment or a particular point in time.

messages.en: This photo was taken back when we were at school, right? I've forgotten who took it.
Yeah, when we were in Form Five. Mr Farid took it, don't you remember?
Oh, right! Then we all went to the canteen, didn't we?

senses.en_definition: A person who leads or is in charge of a group, team, organization, or department.
An elder in a community, distinguished by age and experience.

messages.en: Can we start training at nine tomorrow? I finish work at eight.
Check with the captain first. He's already booked the court, so I'm not sure we can change the time.

senses.en_definition: News or information about a person, event, or situation.
A person's health or general well-being, especially in greetings.

collocations.en: I'm well; good news (in other contexts)

senses.en_definition: Conscious or aware, chiefly in fixed negative expressions meaning unconscious.

messages.en: Hi, Yati! How are you? Haven't heard from you in ages.
I'm good, thank God. I've just moved house, so I've been a bit quiet. How about you?
I'm well too. That explains it! Let's catch up when you're free.
